title: Model Home Hostess
description:
Model Home Hostess – Waterfront Development (Orillia, ON)

Pay: $22/hour (bi‑weekly) Schedule: Saturdays & Sundays, 11 a.m. – 5 p.m. Start Date: July 4, 2026 Job Type: Part‑time, in‑person Duration: approx. 4 months

About the Role

Crossroads Staffing is hiring a professional, friendly Model Home Host to welcome visitors at a new waterfront residential development in Orillia. This role is perfect for someone polished, personable, and reliable who enjoys interacting with the public.

Responsibilities

  • Greet visitors and create a warm, professional first impression

  • Provide basic information about the development and available layouts

  • Guide guests through the model home and highlight key features

  • Keep the showroom tidy, organized, and presentable

  • Record visitor details and relay qualified leads to the Sales Representative

  • Assist with light admin tasks and occasional event setup

Qualifications

  • Strong verbal communication skills

  • Friendly, confident, and professional presentation

  • Organized, detail‑oriented, and able to work independently

  • Reliable and punctual

  • Experience in real estate, hospitality, or customer service is an asset


We are committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace. Any information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

title: Manufacturing Labourer - Afternoon Shift
description:
We are currently hiring Manufacturing Team Members for one of our local clients in Orillia. This opportunity is for the afternoon shift, with hours of work from Monday to Friday, 3:00 pm to 11:00 pm.

Pros to this position are:
  • Afternoon Shift, No early mornings
  • Full time hours and one steady shift
  • $1.50/hr shift premium
  • Weekly Pay, Overtime after 44 hours
  • Training provided

Duties Include:
  • Working on an assembly line in different departments
  • Making parts, cables, elements
  • Placing shorter pieces of metal into large machines stretching and lengthening it to make longer/thinner lengths of cable
  • Working with bigger machines
  • Winding lengths of finished cable on a big machine to wrap
  • Moving product to Carts
  • Testing and quality control
  • Maintaining timelines
  • Making products to set specifications
  • Keeping work area tidy and clean
  • Adhering to workplace health and safety

Requirements:
  • Previous manufacturing experience required
  • Must be available to train on day shift Mon-Fri 7am to 3pm for min 1 week
  • CSA approved steel toed boots
  • Ability to lift up to 50lbs., standing, bending, twisting
  • Ability to use micrometers
  • Reliability/Good attendance
  • Ability to follow direction and a strong willingness to learn
  • Ability to read a tape measure
Weekly pay. Wage $20.00/hr plus $1.50/hr shift premium on all hours worked on afternoon shift.
